title: Correlated Hermite moment
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, let $ oldsymbol{ eta}, oldsymbol{ eta}'\\in bn^n$, and let $ho\in[-1,1]$. If $(X,Y)$ has the law obtained by taking independent standard Gaussian vectors $Z,W\in br^n$ and setting $X=Z$ and $Y=\rho Z+\sqrt{1-\rho^2}W$, then
\[
\mathbb{E}\bigl[H_{\boldsymbol{\beta}}(X)H_{\boldsymbol{\beta}'}(Y)\bigr]=
\begin{cases}
\rho^{|\boldsymbol{\beta}|},&\boldsymbol{\beta}=\boldsymbol{\beta}',\\
0,&\boldsymbol{\beta}\ne\boldsymbol{\beta}',
\end{cases}
\]
where $H_{\boldsymbol{\beta}}$ denotes the multivariate normalized Hermite function and $|\boldsymbol{\beta}|=\sum_{i=1}^n\beta_i$.
hypotheses_covered: Dimension $n$ is a natural number, with no further restriction.
The correlation parameter $\rho$ lies in the closed interval $[-1,1]$.
